d: Clytemnestre, Iphigénie, Greeks and Greeks from their suite, Auliens, Auliennes. Clytemnestre, Iphigénie, arrive in the theatre, mounted on an ancient chariot, accompanied by the women of their suite. This tank is followed and preceded by a magnificationally dressed guard. An immense people sings and follows, dancing and singing
Previous actresses. Achille, Patrocle, Thessalian and Thessalian
The actors of the previous scene. Arcas who entered towards the sin of entertainment
Iphigénie, women of his suite; Arcas, guards, Greeks, behind the theater and at the door of the tent
Iphigénie, Clytemnestre, women. Greeks behind the theater

The theater represents the shore of the sea, on which an altar is stolen. – Iphigénie is led to the altar, surrounded by the prestresses of Diane. Behind the altar is the high priest, the arm extended to the sky, and the sacred knife in the hand. The Greeks in crowd occupy both sides of the theater.
Achilles and the actors of the previous scene. Greeks throwing themselves with terror from the left to the right of the theatre
